[RFCS.15.5] **Canonical serialization.** The persisted body carries the
cross-platform wire obligation the `FactAssert` atom already meets:
deterministic field order, golden vectors matching the codec bit-for-bit
([LDET.3.4.1]). `args` is canonical by construction: sorted by kwarg name, each
value in the single encoding its kind has ([RFCS.23.2]) — a `Float` as an
IEEE-754 double, a `Json` value as canonical JSON text ([LDET.3.2.7]).
